from sklearn.ensemble import RandomForestClassifier
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

def task_func(df, target_column):
    if target_column not in df.columns:
        raise ValueError(f"target_column '{target_column}' not found in dataframe.")

    data = df.copy()

    # Keep only rows with a valid target
    data = data.loc[data[target_column].notna()].copy()
    if data.empty:
        raise ValueError("No valid rows available after removing missing target values.")

    y = data[target_column]
    X = data.drop(columns=[target_column])

    if X.shape[1] == 0:
        raise ValueError("No feature columns available for training.")

    # Encode non-numeric features safely while preserving original column names
    for col in X.columns:
        if not pd.api.types.is_numeric_dtype(X[col]):
            X[col] = X[col].astype("object")
            if X[col].isna().all():
                X[col] = 0
            else:
                mode_values = X[col].mode(dropna=True)
                fill_value = mode_values.iloc[0] if not mode_values.empty else "missing"
                X[col] = X[col].fillna(fill_value)
                X[col] = pd.factorize(X[col])[0]
        else:
            if X[col].isna().all():
                X[col] = 0
            else:
                X[col] = X[col].fillna(X[col].median())

    # Encode target if needed
    if not pd.api.types.is_numeric_dtype(y):
        y = pd.factorize(y)[0]
    else:
        y = y.fillna(y.mode(dropna=True).iloc[0] if not y.mode(dropna=True).empty else 0)

    clf = RandomForestClassifier(random_state=42)
    clf.fit(X, y)

    feature_importances = clf.feature_importances_
    importance_df = pd.DataFrame({
        "Features": X.columns,
        "Feature Importance Score": feature_importances
    }).sort_values(by="Feature Importance Score", ascending=False)

    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10, max(4, 0.4 * len(importance_df))))
    sns.barplot(
        data=importance_df,
        x="Feature Importance Score",
        y="Features",
        ax=ax,
        orient="h",
        color="steelblue"
    )

    ax.set_xlabel("Feature Importance Score")
    ax.set_ylabel("Features")
    ax.set_title("Visualizing Important Features")
    plt.tight_layout()

    return clf, ax
